transcript:
Gradually the prophetic power overcame her, and she uttered a Greek verse in the voice of the God.
To a fawning fellowship, he shall stab a cluck and trip, dribbling always with his lip.
O Sibyl, I have come to question you about Rome's fate and mine.
source: Derek Jacobi · I, Claudius — solo abridged Jacobi reading, Canongate CSA Audio
